requirements.TS-01: Restore normal UIParent-relative GameTooltip size when Flux takes HUD/default-anchor ownership; shrinking and oversized residual scales must not leak to later hovers.
requirements.TS-02: Keep exact HUD anchor (0,30), existing single native tooltip, native scripts/fonts/health, input and refresh cadence.
requirements.TS-03: Respect explicit public TacoTipConfig.tooltip_scale; use native scale1 otherwise. Read preferences live; never edit external addons or settings.
requirements.TS-04: Skip invalid/opaque scale values, forbidden frames, protected combat frames and Edit Mode layout ownership. Do not modify native container or unrelated tooltip scales.
requirements.TS-05: No new event/hook/timer/frame/ticker/polling. Stable scale does not produce repeat writes.

observation: User confirms the whole tooltip including border shrinks. Desktop actual-HUD fixture reproduces inherited .2/.35/.64 scale before candidate; native originating writer/parent chain remains unobserved.
attributionLimits: Installed Skillet 5.66 has conditional shared-GameTooltip SetScale writers; TacoTip1.0.2 has explicit tooltip_scale preference/writers. Their active settings/execution at the incident are NOT established. No claim that either addon caused this particular report.
implementation: RestoreTooltipScale runs only in existing HUD placement/default-anchor hook. Default scale1 tracks native UI scale through UIParent; a scaled non-UIParent parent is compensated using public scale values. Existing explicit TacoTip preference wins. No SetScale hook, method replacement, global frame fields or settings write.
